description: Static 3D radius scaling at four million uniform integer points
name: radius_scaling_3d
geometry: closed Euclidean spheres on uint32 grid
coordinate_generation: uniform per axis; normal mean 0.5 standard deviation 0.125 clipped to [0,1]; skew has uniform x and independent exponential y,z with mean 0.1 clipped to [0,1]; nearest uint32 integer
radius_policy: Round radius_fraction * UINT32_MAX to nearest integer; square this integer exactly. No pilot calibration.

comparison_contract.output: native materialized points or indices for non-SPRK implementations; SPRK configurations unchanged
comparison_contract.measurement: single-core jobs; existing shared budgets and timeouts; three final repetitions

exceptions.esa_sprk_CHEATING_IDS_ONLY: SPRK (original): expanded f64 ball and materialized point IDs; eligible for normalization, with its distinct contract disclosed.

query_design: Fixed radii as fractions of uint32 grid width; identical indexed points and query centers across radii for each seed.
title: radius_scaling

radius_design.boundary_effects: Query centers cover the whole cube; balls intersecting boundaries return fewer points. Actual counts are measured.
